question: 如果所有素菜打八折，且羊肉串买二送一，则这餐饭人均便宜多少钱？

steps.description: Locate the vegetable dish '菜花' in the pre-bill and read its price
Locate the vegetable dish '娃娃菜' in the pre-bill and read its price
Locate the vegetable dish '千叶豆腐' in the pre-bill and read its price
Locate the vegetable dish '香菇' in the pre-bill and read its price
Sum the prices of all vegetable dishes from steps 1-4
Calculate savings from 20% discount on total vegetable price
Locate the '羊肉串' item in the pre-bill and read its total price
Locate the quantity of '羊肉串' in the pre-bill
Divide the total price of '羊肉串' by its quantity to get unit price
Calculate savings from buy-2-get-1-free promotion on lamb skewers
Add vegetable discount savings and lamb skewer savings together
Locate the number of customers in the pre-bill
Divide total savings by the number of customers to get per person savings
